sentences.text:
Debananda Patra vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 11
December, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Represented By Adv.
 -Mr. Jyotirmaya Sahoo.

Opposite Party
 Represented By Adv.
 -Ms. Babita Kumari Sahu, Aga.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (Virtual/ Physical) mode.
2. This bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 of the Petitioner arising out of C.T. Case No.125 of 2023 in connection with Jamda P.S. Case No.82 of 2023 is taken up for consideration.
3. I have already heard from the learned Counsel for the Petitioner and the learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

4. The accused is facing trial in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.S.C) under POCSO Act, Mayurbhanj, Baripada, having been charged under Section- 376(3)/376(1) of the I.P.C.
read with Section-4(2) of the POCSO Act and Section-5 & 6 of the Odisha Prevention of Witch Hunting Act, 2023.
5.

entities.text: Odisha Prevention of Witch Hunting Act, 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In the meantime, the trial of the case has been progressed substantially completing the examination of the victim as P.W.2, for which, at this stage, instead of allowing the Petitioner to go on bail, it is felt proper to direct the learned Trial Court to conclude the trial of the case vide C.T.
Case No.125 of 2023 as expeditiously as possible within a period of two and half months hence,
failing which the Petitioner may renew his prayer for bail.
6. Therefore, the prayer for bail of the Petitioner is refused and accordingly his application stands rejected.

The Registry is to communicate this order to learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.S.C) under POCSO Act, Mayurbhanj, Baripada in connection with C.T. Case No.25 of 2025.
7.
Grant certified copy of this order to the Petitioner on proper application.
